Savings account
Opened by salaried persons / persons who have a fixed regular income.
There is no restriction on the number of deposits.

Current account
Opened by businessmen who have a large number of regular transactions.
Deposited or withdrawn any number of times in a day
Opened by only businessmen.
Consumers have to pay service charges for their deposits
